resources.string: TEMPER reads up to eight visible plain-text messages, sent/received roles and composer position in one supported WhatsApp chat you select. Review and opt in inside TEMPER first. Normal analysis runs on this phone without saving or uploading chats. Optional quality feedback requires separate permission: a selected session can keep up to 64 visible turns and estimates in memory for ten minutes, then send reviewed text only when you choose Send rating. Leaving the selected chat stops capture. Revoke or discard clears pending feedback. TEMPER never clicks chat controls or sends messages. Estimates can be wrong.
